summary: gh plate bootstrap now uploads the checked-in PLATE template payload into new repositories while preserving any files that already exist.
migration_impact: Downstream repositories initialized with `gh plate bootstrap --apply` will now receive the repository-level PLATE scaffold (AGENTS, docs, workflows, scripts, starter assets) in addition to the existing GitHub-side bootstrap work. Rerunning bootstrap leaves existing files untouched.
agent_notes: Treat the template payload manifest as the source of truth for repository-scaffold files. The new bootstrap phase uploads the selected payload files through the GitHub contents API and skips any file that already exists. `.plate` remains a separate bootstrap artifact.
